diff --git a/encryption/config.go b/encryption/config.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9bc15c3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/encryption/config.go
@@ -0,0 +1,148 @@
+package encryption
+
+import (
+	"crypto/pbkdf2"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/base64"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+const (
+	KeySourceEnv     = "env"
+	KeySourceFile    = "file"
+	KeySourceLiteral = "literal"
+	KeySourceDerive  = "derive"
+
+	MinSaltSize      = 16
+	deriveIterations = 600_000
+)
+
+type Config struct {
+	Enabled    bool   `yaml:"enabled"`
+	KeySource  string `yaml:"keysource"`
+	KeyEnvVar  string `yaml:"keyenvvar"`
+	KeyFile    string `yaml:"keyfile"`
+	Key        string `yaml:"key"`
+	Passphrase string `yaml:"passphrase"`
+	Salt       string `yaml:"salt"`
+}
+
+func (c Config) source() string {
+	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(c.KeySource))
+}
+
+// Validate checks the config is consistent. Disabled configs are always valid.
+func (c Config) Validate() error {
+	if !c.Enabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	fields := []struct {
+		name   string
+		value  string
+		source string
+	}{
+		{"keyenvvar", c.KeyEnvVar, KeySourceEnv},
+		{"keyfile", c.KeyFile, KeySourceFile},
+		{"key", c.Key, KeySourceLiteral},
+		{"passphrase", c.Passphrase, KeySourceDerive},
+		{"salt", c.Salt, KeySourceDerive},
+	}
+
+	source := c.source()
+	switch source {
+	case "":
+		return errors.New("encryption key source is required when encryption is enabled")
+	case KeySourceEnv, KeySourceFile, KeySourceLiteral, KeySourceDerive:
+	default:
+		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported encryption key source %q, must be one of env, file, literal, derive", c.KeySource)
+	}
+
+	var errs error
+	for _, f := range fields {
+		set := strings.TrimSpace(f.value) != ""
+		if f.source == source && !set {
+			errs = errors.Join(errs, fmt.Errorf("encryption %s is required for key source %q", f.name, source))
+		}
+		if f.source != source && set {
+			errs = errors.Join(errs, fmt.Errorf("encryption %s and key source %q are mutually exclusive", f.name, source))
+		}
+	}
+
+	return errs
+}
+
+// LoadKey loads the 32-byte encryption key described by cfg.
+func LoadKey(cfg Config) ([]byte, error) {
+	switch cfg.source() {
+	case KeySourceEnv:
+		name := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.KeyEnvVar)
+		if name == "" {
+			return nil, errors.New("encryption key env var name is required")
+		}
+		value, ok := os.LookupEnv(name)
+		if !ok || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("encryption key env var %q is not set", name)
+		}
+		return decodeKey(value)
+	case KeySourceFile:
+		path := strings.TrimSpace(cfg.KeyFile)
+		if path == "" {
+			return nil, errors.New("encryption key file is required")
+		}
+		content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
+		if err != nil {
+			return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read encryption key file: %w", err)
+		}
+		return decodeKey(string(content))
+	case KeySourceLiteral:
+		if strings.TrimSpace(cfg.Key) == "" {
+			return nil, errors.New("encryption key is required")
+		}
+		return decodeKey(cfg.Key)
+	case KeySourceDerive:
+		return deriveKey(cfg.Passphrase, cfg.Salt)
+	case "":
+		return nil, errors.New("encryption key source is required")
+	default:
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported encryption key source %q", cfg.KeySource)
+	}
+}
+
+func decodeKey(encoded string) ([]byte, error) {
+	key, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(strings.TrimSpace(encoded))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: key is not valid base64: %v", ErrInvalidKey, err)
+	}
+
+	if len(key) != KeySize {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: expected %d bytes, got %d", ErrInvalidKey, KeySize, len(key))
+	}
+
+	return key, nil
+}
+
+func deriveKey(passphrase, encodedSalt string) ([]byte, error) {
+	if passphrase == "" {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: encryption passphrase must not be empty", ErrInvalidKey)
+	}
+
+	salt, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(strings.TrimSpace(encodedSalt))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: encryption salt is not valid base64: %v", ErrInvalidKey, err)
+	}
+
+	if len(salt) < MinSaltSize {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: encryption salt must be at least %d bytes, got %d", ErrInvalidKey, MinSaltSize, len(salt))
+	}
+
+	key, err := pbkdf2.Key(sha256.New, passphrase, salt, deriveIterations, KeySize)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to derive encryption key: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	return key, nil
+}
diff --git a/encryption/config_test.go b/encryption/config_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..acc3ae2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/encryption/config_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+package encryption
+
+import (
+	"bytes"
+	"encoding/base64"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+var (
+	rawKey  = bytes.Repeat([]byte{7}, KeySize)
+	b64Key  = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(rawKey)
+	b64Salt = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(bytes.Repeat([]byte{1}, MinSaltSize))
+)
+
+func TestValidate(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name    string
+		cfg     Config
+		wantErr string
+	}{
+		{"disabled", Config{KeySource: "bogus", Key: "x", KeyFile: "y"}, ""},
+		{"missing source", Config{Enabled: true}, "required"},
+		{"unsupported source", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "kms"}, "unsupported"},
+		{"env", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "ENV", KeyEnvVar: "K"}, ""},
+		{"env missing var", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "env"}, "required"},
+		{"env with key", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "env", KeyEnvVar: "K", Key: b64Key}, "mutually exclusive"},
+		{"file", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "File", KeyFile: "/k"}, ""},
+		{"file with passphrase", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "file", KeyFile: "/k", Passphrase: "p"}, "mutually exclusive"},
+		{"literal", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "literal", Key: b64Key}, ""},
+		{"literal with env", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "literal", Key: b64Key, KeyEnvVar: "K"}, "mutually exclusive"},
+		{"derive", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "p", Salt: b64Salt}, ""},
+		{"derive missing salt", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "p"}, "required"},
+		{"derive with file", Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "p", Salt: b64Salt, KeyFile: "/k"}, "mutually exclusive"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			err := tt.cfg.Validate()
+			if tt.wantErr == "" {
+				assert.NoError(t, err)
+			} else {
+				assert.ErrorContains(t, err, tt.wantErr)
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestLoadKeyEnv(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Setenv("ONEDUMP_TEST_KEY", b64Key)
+	key, err := LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "env", KeyEnvVar: "ONEDUMP_TEST_KEY"})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, rawKey, key)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "env", KeyEnvVar: "ONEDUMP_TEST_KEY_UNSET"})
+	assert.Error(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestLoadKeyFile(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "key")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("  "+b64Key+"\n"), 0o600))
+
+	key, err := LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "file", KeyFile: path})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, rawKey, key)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "file", KeyFile: path + ".missing"})
+	assert.Error(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestLoadKeyLiteral(t *testing.T) {
+	key, err := LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "Literal", Key: b64Key})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, rawKey, key)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "literal", Key: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("short"))})
+	assert.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidKey)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "literal", Key: "not base64!"})
+	assert.Error(t, err)
+}
+
+func TestLoadKeyDerive(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "secret", Salt: b64Salt}
+	k1, err := LoadKey(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Len(t, k1, KeySize)
+
+	k2, err := LoadKey(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.Equal(t, k1, k2)
+
+	cfg.Passphrase = "other"
+	k3, err := LoadKey(cfg)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	assert.NotEqual(t, k1, k3)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "", Salt: b64Salt})
+	assert.Error(t, err)
+
+	_, err = LoadKey(Config{Enabled: true, KeySource: "derive", Passphrase: "p", Salt: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte("short"))})
+	assert.Error(t, err)
+}
diff --git a/encryption/encryption.go b/encryption/encryption.go
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8ce4b33
--- /dev/null
+++ b/encryption/encryption.go
@@ -0,0 +1,304 @@
+// Package encryption provides AES-256-GCM streaming encryption for dump files.
+//
+// Stream format:
+//
+//	header:   magic (0x4F 0x44) + version (0x01)
+//	chunks:   4-byte big-endian length (nonce+ciphertext+tag) | 12-byte nonce | ciphertext+16-byte tag
+//	sentinel: 4 zero bytes
+//	trailer:  32-byte HMAC-SHA256 over every byte between the header and the sentinel
+package encryption
+
+import (
+	"crypto/aes"
+	"crypto/cipher"
+	"crypto/hmac"
+	"crypto/rand"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/binary"
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"hash"
+	"io"
+)
+
+const (
+	KeySize        = 32
+	ChunkSize      = 64 * 1024
+	Version   byte = 0x01
+
+	nonceSize  = 12
+	tagSize    = 16
+	lengthSize = 4
+	macSize    = sha256.Size
+	maxRecord  = nonceSize + ChunkSize + tagSize
+)
+
+var (
+	ErrInvalidKey = errors.New("invalid encryption key")
+	ErrClosed     = errors.New("encryption writer is closed")
+
+	magic = []byte{0x4F, 0x44}
+)
+
+type Encryptor struct {
+	key  []byte
+	aead cipher.AEAD
+}
+
+// NewEncryptor creates an AES-256-GCM encryptor; the key must be exactly 32 bytes.
+func NewEncryptor(key []byte) (*Encryptor, error) {
+	aead, err := newAEAD(key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	k := make([]byte, len(key))
+	copy(k, key)
+
+	return &Encryptor{key: k, aead: aead}, nil
+}
+
+func newAEAD(key []byte) (cipher.AEAD, error) {
+	if len(key) != KeySize {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: expected %d bytes, got %d", ErrInvalidKey, KeySize, len(key))
+	}
+
+	block, err := aes.NewCipher(key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", ErrInvalidKey, err)
+	}
+
+	return cipher.NewGCM(block)
+}
+
+// EncryptWriter returns a writer that encrypts everything written to it into w.
+// Close must be called to flush the final chunk and write the trailer; it does not close w.
+func (e *Encryptor) EncryptWriter(w io.Writer) io.WriteCloser {
+	return &encryptWriter{
+		w:    w,
+		aead: e.aead,
+		mac:  hmac.New(sha256.New, e.key),
+		buf:  make([]byte, 0, ChunkSize),
+	}
+}
+
+type encryptWriter struct {
+	w             io.Writer
+	aead          cipher.AEAD
+	mac           hash.Hash
+	buf           []byte
+	headerWritten bool
+	closed        bool
+	err           error
+}
+
+func (ew *encryptWriter) writeHeader() error {
+	if ew.headerWritten {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ew.headerWritten = true
+	_, err := ew.w.Write(append(append([]byte{}, magic...), Version))
+	return err
+}
+
+func (ew *encryptWriter) Write(p []byte) (int, error) {
+	if ew.closed {
+		return 0, ErrClosed
+	}
+
+	if ew.err != nil {
+		return 0, ew.err
+	}
+
+	if err := ew.writeHeader(); err != nil {
+		ew.err = err
+		return 0, err
+	}
+
+	written := 0
+	for len(p) > 0 {
+		n := min(ChunkSize-len(ew.buf), len(p))
+		ew.buf = append(ew.buf, p[:n]...)
+		p = p[n:]
+		written += n
+
+		if len(ew.buf) == ChunkSize {
+			if err := ew.flush(); err != nil {
+				ew.err = err
+				return written, err
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	return written, nil
+}
+
+func (ew *encryptWriter) flush() error {
+	if len(ew.buf) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	record := make([]byte, lengthSize+nonceSize, lengthSize+nonceSize+len(ew.buf)+tagSize)
+	nonce := record[lengthSize:]
+	if _, err := io.ReadFull(rand.Reader, nonce); err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("failed to generate nonce: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	record = ew.aead.Seal(record, nonce, ew.buf, nil)
+	binary.BigEndian.PutUint32(record[:lengthSize], uint32(len(record)-lengthSize))
+
+	ew.mac.Write(record)
+	ew.buf = ew.buf[:0]
+
+	_, err := ew.w.Write(record)
+	return err
+}
+
+func (ew *encryptWriter) Close() error {
+	if ew.closed {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ew.closed = true
+
+	if ew.err != nil {
+		return ew.err
+	}
+
+	if err := ew.writeHeader(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	if err := ew.flush(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+
+	trailer := make([]byte, lengthSize, lengthSize+macSize)
+	trailer = ew.mac.Sum(trailer)
+
+	_, err := ew.w.Write(trailer)
+	return err
+}
+
+// DecryptReader returns a reader that decrypts and verifies a stream produced by EncryptWriter.
+// The stream is parsed lazily, so header, integrity and truncation errors are returned from Read.
+func DecryptReader(r io.Reader, key []byte) (io.Reader, error) {
+	aead, err := newAEAD(key)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+
+	return &decryptReader{
+		r:    r,
+		aead: aead,
+		mac:  hmac.New(sha256.New, key),
+	}, nil
+}
+
+type decryptReader struct {
+	r        io.Reader
+	aead     cipher.AEAD
+	mac      hash.Hash
+	started  bool
+	done     bool
+	err      error
+	plain    []byte
+	recordBf []byte
+}
+
+func (dr *decryptReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
+	for len(dr.plain) == 0 {
+		if dr.err != nil {
+			return 0, dr.err
+		}
+
+		if dr.done {
+			return 0, io.EOF
+		}
+
+		if err := dr.next(); err != nil {
+			dr.err = err
+		}
+	}
+
+	n := copy(p, dr.plain)
+	dr.plain = dr.plain[n:]
+	return n, nil
+}
+
+func unexpected(err error, what string) error {
+	if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || errors.Is(err, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
+		return fmt.Errorf("truncated encrypted stream: missing %s: %w", what, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF)
+	}
+	return fmt.Errorf("failed to read %s: %w", what, err)
+}
+
+// next reads the header (on first call) and then one record from the underlying reader.
+func (dr *decryptReader) next() error {
+	if !dr.started {
+		dr.started = true
+		header := make([]byte, len(magic)+1)
+		if _, err := io.ReadFull(dr.r, header); err != nil {
+			if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) || errors.Is(err, io.ErrUnexpectedEOF) {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid header: stream too short: %w", io.ErrUnexpectedEOF)
+			}
+			return fmt.Errorf("failed to read header: %w", err)
+		}
+
+		if header[0] != magic[0] || header[1] != magic[1] {
+			return errors.New("invalid header: bad magic bytes")
+		}
+
+		if header[2] != Version {
+			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported version: %d", header[2])
+		}
+	}
+
+	var lenBuf [lengthSize]byte
+	if _, err := io.ReadFull(dr.r, lenBuf[:]); err != nil {
+		return unexpected(err, "chunk length")
+	}
+
+	length := binary.BigEndian.Uint32(lenBuf[:])
+	if length == 0 {
+		return dr.finish()
+	}
+
+	if length < nonceSize+tagSize || length > maxRecord {
+		return fmt.Errorf("invalid chunk length %d: integrity check failed", length)
+	}
+
+	if cap(dr.recordBf) < int(length) {
+		dr.recordBf = make([]byte, maxRecord)
+	}
+	record := dr.recordBf[:length]
+	if _, err := io.ReadFull(dr.r, record); err != nil {
+		return unexpected(err, "chunk data")
